points.why: Covers the two-to-three-year construction lag and notes that most units haven't arrived, but never says rent figures also lag because they reflect leases signed months earlier.
Warns that reacting harder to a structurally late signal causes overcorrection and criticizes bundling, noting the suburban rezoning has the same delay.
Recommends tracking permits, starts and completions, estimates when units arrive, and sets a review checkpoint with completion thresholds instead of repealing.
Recommends sequencing changes and a modest time-limited bridge, and points to the regional trend and financing costs as outside influences.
